Class PF1

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.GenericFileProtocol
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.proj.ProjectFile
com.j3d.storage.files.protocol.proj.PF1
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileProtocol
public final class PF1 extends ProjectFile
PF1 is a J3D file protocol implementation for reading and writing project files that contain layer and thing information to and from disk.

Typically .j3p files

The Exact format is as follows:

    J3D Header (UTF-8)
    J3D Version (int)
    PROJECT Header (UTF-8)
    PROJECT Header Version (int)
    Number of Layers (int)
    For each Layer:
      Layer Identifier (UTF-8)
      Layer Hidden (boolean)
    Number of points in project (int)
    For each point:
      Point UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      X Coordinate (double)
      Y Coordinate (double)
      Z Coordinate (double)
    Number of lines in project (int)
    For each line:
      Line UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      Start Point UUID (UTF-8)
      End Point UUID (UTF-8)
    Number of triangles in project (int)
    For each triangle:
      Triangle UUID (UTF-8)
      Thing Parent UUID (UTF-8)
      Colour Red (int)
      Colour Green (int)
      Colour Blue (int)
      Colour Alpha (int)
      Line 1 UUID (UTF-8)
      Line 2 UUID (UTF-8)
      Line 3 UUID (UTF-8)
    For each Layer:
      Layer Index (int)
      Number of Things in Layer (int)
      For each Thing:
        Thing UUID (UTF-8)
        Thing Name (UTF-8)
        Thing Visibility (boolean)
        ... Multiple lines UUIDs of lines points and tris that the thing owns (UTF-8)
